name: pitmaster

plugins.name: pitmaster
plugins.description: Grill the plan before it starts (bbq), record decisions as ADRs (makeadr), find the bottleneck (swarm-bottleneck), pick the budget (budget-select) and the models (tier-select), log what it cost (spend-ledger), let the agent pick the work (dealers-choice) under standing authority (carte-blanche), and prep a new project (project-prep).
